question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you want Kay and Kel as your sisters?
Would you rather do tricks or get treats?

nodes.text: Howard and the twins hit each decorated house on the block like a set of highly-trained mercenaries!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See how you can maximize your candy potential by checking out the front yard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This house has all the best decorations! They've got fake tombstones, cobwebs, and skeletons.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But the lights are off... So they aren't home.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Exactly! But with this many decorations, you can bet your eyepatch and fake parrot that they left out an unattended bowl of candy.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Unattended candy!
A few minutes of frantic candy-grubbing later...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That was awesome, big brother!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We have enough candy to make us throw up! Twice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, anything for my little sisters. So you guys ready to go home? It's getting pretty late...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No way! We want to hit up that neighborhood over there!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Besides, we're having too much fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's great that they're having fun... But I need to get to Linda.
Howard and the twins stumble through one failure after another!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man... My candy-fu is weak tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I thought that mean dog was going to chew your face off, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And they didn't even give us any candy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe you shouldn't have egged their house last year!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: This bites! Our bags are only half-full of candy.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I wanted to see how much I could eat before throwing up...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Now we'll never know!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay... I guess there's another neighborhood over there...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: There'd better be! And they'd better have candy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're getting that candy if it takes us all night!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great. This is taking forever!
Soon...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: C'mon, girls. We've been at this for half an hour!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Candy! Candy! Candy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Arrrrrr!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to have to speed these twerps up if I'm going to see Linda at all tonight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've got to get the most candy from the least houses. Let's see...  Houses with a lot of decorations up usually give out more candy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we're probably not going to have any luck with the houses that the twins pulled pranks on last year!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Kay and Kel, do you two want even more candy?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: More glorious booty!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Arr-righty! Follow me! The trick to getting more candy in Halloween is to go to homes that show the most Halloween spirit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not one for holding up the fun.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww, it's okay. I know how much you wanted to see this haunted house. We can wait.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way. I insist. My folks gave me some chores to do, and it'll take me a while.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, don't worry. I'll catch up. See you soon.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay. I'll wait. See you soon!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I really need to hurry the twins!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard! Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: All the houses on that street are giving out candy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm gonna be stuck with them forever!
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, okay... This isn't the end of the world... If I rush these two as fast as I can, I bet I can get to Linda before it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, you two better not play any tricks tonight. I don't have the time to keep you girls out of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That's okay, matey. We have a plan.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: After we play a trick, we'll change into our regular clothes so no one will recognize us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That won't work. Trust me, I tried it last Halloween. What I really needed was a backup costume...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: He's right!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... Wait... Don't take that advice. You can't...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second, girls! My phone's ringing!
Howard answers his phone.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, babe, but I got held up. Are you at the haunted house?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah. Dinah and I have been waiting here for a while now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man... What should I tell her?

options.label: Can you wait a little longer?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: How can you say that, Howard? The twins love you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Love me?! I woke up this morning duct-taped to my bed!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, you know they get their mischievous sense of humor from you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: After all, imitation is the highest form of flattery.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now be a great brother and my favorite son...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And make sure they don't get into any trouble.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, all right, mom. Way to lay on the guilt.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's a necessary skill to deal with this family.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Hey! I'm perfectly reasonable! It's the rest of the world that's the problem!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda's expecting me! I can't let her down!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You'd better let her down! You still owe us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: For what?! I haven't done anything to deserve this!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You still owe us money for burning down the tree and front lawn!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, right. The Fourth of July Incident...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I've been subtracting your debt from your allowance.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: According to my books, taking the twins out should zero out the balance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can't I float the debt until later?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Fine. You can be grounded as collateral. Starting now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I'll take the twins trick-or-treating.
Later that night, on the way to yet another neighborhood...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, girls, we're just about done... There's no way you'd want to do any more trick-or-treating!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: More candy! More booty! More plunder!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: C'mon, matey! Look! We haven't been to that neighborhood over there! I bet it's just teeming with land-lubbers and their grubby lot!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, don't wimp out now, you scallywag!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Arggggh! At this rate, I'm going to stand Linda up! Time to get desperate...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I have an idea. There's that new haunted house a few blocks away!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's take a break and check it out!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Haunted houses are lame!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We don't like them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I promise that it will be fun!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But... The plunder...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The lollipops... The gumdrops... The bubblegum...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There will be plenty of time for more candy, you scurvy dogs! Just give the haunted house a chance! Then I'll `buy` you all the candy you can eat!
nodes.text_bbcode: There will be plenty of time for more candy, you scurvy dogs! Just give the haunted house a chance! Then I'll [color=#e23b3b][i]buy[/i][/color] you all the candy you can eat!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we get to go back to trick-or-treating after!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Deal. You two won't regret it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do ya got, girls?
The girls pull out a couple of giant firecrackers from their bags!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... Are those from my personal collection?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, don't get mad at us.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, we rescued them from Dad. He found your stash under your bed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! Dad is such a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we have this other jerk to take care of. Give those things to me!
Howard snatches the firecrackers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No one insults this family and gets away with it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You girls go hide!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now to light the fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then ring the doorbell!
Suddenly, the lights go out... All over the neighborhood!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What the...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: What in tarnation is going on here?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yikes!
Boom!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That was a cool explosion!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Especially after we blew out the power! That was `awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Especially after we blew out the power! That was [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You turned out the power? But how are we going to see where we're going in the dark?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We'll... Um... Walk slow?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now the trick-or-treating is going to take even longer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, girls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let me take care of this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sir! I demand satisfaction!
Howard pounds on the door, and an old, cranky man throws it open!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: Who in tarnation are you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! What's the matter with you? My sisters just wanted some Halloween candy!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: The apple don't fall far from the tree! And that's double-true when the tree backed over my lawn gnome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First off, I don't think that's the expression. And second, I'm nothing like my father!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just trying to take my little sisters out for a fun night, and now you've ruined it!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Waaahhh!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! They're really upset!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My dad might be a jerk, but my sisters don't deserve this treatment. They're good kids, and I love them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So are you going to be a jerk, or are you going to step up and apologize to them?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: I gotta give it to you, kid. It takes a brave fella to stand up to an intimidating son of a gun like me.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: You've got guts, you've got heart, and you seem like a straight shooter. Maybe I wasn't being fair to you kids.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: Take this bag of candy and tell the little gals that I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: But if you see that no-good pop of yours, you tell him he owes me a garden gnome!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Wow! That was great! You're the best big brother ever!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, you recovered really fast. You're not upset?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We were faking! But did you really mean all that stuff you said? Do you really 'wuv' us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, sure?
The twins dive forward and hug Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We love you too, big brother!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay! Okay! This is getting seriously cheesy! Let go!
Howard and the twins arrive at the next house, and the twins run up to the door...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trick or treat!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yarrrr!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, look at that! Those sure are cute pirate costumes!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I recognize you two! I know your dad! He backed over one of my garden gnomes and never apologized!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: Get out! Get out now! You don't get any candy if you can't respect the decency of a garden gnome!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aahh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What the heck is going on up there?
The twins come running back in tears!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Help, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Craby
nodes.text: And you tell your Dad that he owes me a new gnome! And it better be fancy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The rotten land-lubber didn't give us any candy!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: He said Dad ran over his gnome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! Dad would never do that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Maybe he would...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But that doesn't give him the right to pick on you two!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We have a prank for the big meanie!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And you're the perfect person to pull it off, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I should...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I should have waited for you, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I said it was okay...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I don't know anything about haunted houses...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I've been lost ever since I walked in here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know that if you had been here this would never have happened!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Slow down... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A school hallway? Is this supposed to be scary?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmm... What does that poster say?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Finals today!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is scary!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... That scent... That's Linda's perfume!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda! Are you here?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard?
Linda climbs out of a fake locker.
The two hug each other quickly.
After a few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I think I see the exit! That's where their voices are coming from!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's, uh, Dinah. I'm a little worried about Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, it's fine! Dinah's way too goth to be scared by some dumb, haunted house!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean, it's not like she's a little girl or anything!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right... Because it would be really bad... If she were...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's keep exploring!
Howard and Linda continue exploring the haunted house and come across a surreal sight...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are those kid-sized clowns real or animatronic puppets?

nodes.speaker: Clown Kid
nodes.text: Can I have some more? I'm still hungry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm more frightened of that lunch lady clown!

nodes.speaker: Lunch Lady
nodes.text: You'll eat your share of brains and no more!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's keep going. Normal school scares me enough!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Help! Where are you, big brother?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Hear what? I can only hear the... Screams of clown children eating cafeteria food!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Why did you leave us, big brother?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That... That definitely sounds like one of your sisters!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It has to be the weird acoustics of this place. There is no way the twins are here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We can hear you, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Save us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... I'm really getting creeped out! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I left them on the porch of the house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They were too scared to come in.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Have they been waiting there all this time?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... Yeah... But I thought it was better than them freaking out...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure, but why didn't you mention this earlier?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the first time you and I have had time alone. I wanted to enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's sweet...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But we should try and get back to your sisters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have a confession to make... The twins are here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They're here in the house?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no! I forgot that the twins are still waiting for me on the porch!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... I hope you're not mad that I went on ahead.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mad? Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd rather have you have some fun while I had to deal with...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... Some errands... My parents had me do errands.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Errands? On Halloween?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know parents. They never respect old-fashioned traditions!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Old people these days. Always doing things at the last minute.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thinking only of themselves.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha ha! You're a big dork!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm really relieved that you're here. I've been wandering around this house for an hour!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ew... This is a scene straight out of 'Hacksaw'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is... Is that a dead body?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it moving?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I have come for your soul, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mommy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha ha! I can't believe I scared you! I thought you loved haunted houses!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I do! I was... Getting into the spirit of things!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. Wait here on the porch. I'll only take a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll get Linda, and then we'll all go trick-or-treating. Okay?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay. We'll wait here.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And don't just find Linda to make out with her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! I would never... Okay, maybe I would...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll get Linda and come right back. Promise.
Howard enters the haunted house alone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This doesn't look so scary. What's that supposed to be? A haunted microphone?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmm...I've texted Linda twice already. Maybe this house blocks signals.
Howard checks his phone...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... No signal.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No choice now but to continue on.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, a haunted house is all about having fun! You two like fun, right?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But... But it looks scary!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's either that, or I leave you here on the porch!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who knows what scary thing might pop up here?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No! Don't leave us here! We'll go!
Howard and the twins enter the haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See? There's nothing scary here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, so far it looks pretty boring... It looks like a cheesy soundstage...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two scaredy-cats okay now?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What's that?
A curtain parts, and a tall, scary clown jumps out!

nodes.speaker: Killer Clown
nodes.text: Boo! Join my circus! Forever!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Nooo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! That's really scary! That's not a real chainsaw, is it?

nodes.speaker: Killer Clown
nodes.text: Let me carve you a new smile!
The killer clown disappears back behind the curtain.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... Maybe you two should wait outside...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay? Kel?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Shoot. It looks like they ran deeper into the haunted house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now I have to find them `and` Linda...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I have to find them [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Linda...

nodes.text: Howard and the twins finally arrive at the haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is going to be great! Ghosts! Goblins! Scary clowns!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: S... Scary clowns?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Do we have to go in, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course we do! I mean, Halloween is all about getting scared out of your wits!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We... We don't want to be scared out of our wits!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Let's go back to trick-or-treating! Please! We'll be good pirates!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: C'mon, girls. I just want to see Linda. She's in there somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We don't want to go in!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's up with them?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I thought you said the twins weren't with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... Er... Lied? Unsuccessfully?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Why would you lie about that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't understand how much of a nuisance they are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They've been keeping me from seeing you all night! It's their fault they're missing!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! How can you say that about your sisters?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Easy! And I'll say it a again, 'Good riddance!'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I never realized that you were such a jerk! I'm going home!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But I got rid of them for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda! I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not the one you should apologize to!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... I had two little sisters with me. Have you seen them?

nodes.speaker: Killer Clown
nodes.text: Er... Sorry. You two were the last ones left. There's no one in the house now.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope the twins are okay...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait a minute. This isn't a door. It's a wall painted to look like a door!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Heh heh!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's going on? Where are those voices coming from?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You thought you could leave us behind, big brother?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Just so you and Linda could be together?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... It was an accident! It was a mistake!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wouldn't do anything to hurt you two!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ha ha! Like we believe that!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: All you care about is Linda.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Linda! Linda! Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm... Getting scared. Is this a joke?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See what you're doing? You're scaring Linda!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It's okay, Howard. You're there to protect her.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You can protect her... Forever!
Suddenly, the walls start shaking! Chairs start moving on their own! The faces of the twins appear in all the mirrors on the walls!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's going on? How... How are you doing this?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We found this creepy old book full of ancient spells and curses! It said anyone who reads it out loud would gain terrrrible powers!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We read it out loud!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I gathered that...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! We've got to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: There's no escape from this house!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We control it now! We are one with the house!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wouldn't that be 'three' with the house?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Silence!

nodes.speaker: Kay
